name: Sven Mikser - § 7 - Am 7
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Moldova
part_text: 7. Regrets, at a time when European citizens are facing economic hardship, the creation of the Reform and Growth Facility for Moldova, worth EUR 2.02 billion; calls for strict conditionality, full transparency, and independent audit mechanisms to ensure that funds are effectively spent and not misused or diverted to politically motivated structures;
